observation.command:
cd /tmp && rm -f op4.txt
CSRF=$(curl -s -c op4.txt --max-time 30 http://localhost:8080/login | grep -oE 'name="authenticity_token" value="[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//')
curl -s -b op4.txt -c op4.txt --max-time 30 \
  -d "authenticity_token=$CSRF&username=admin&password=admin" \
  http://localhost:8080/login > body.html
grep -oiE "flash-error[^>]*>[^<]{0,120}|<title>[^<]*</title>" body.html | head -6
docker logs openproject 2>&1 | grep -iE "Failed login" | tail -3
